artifact: GLM-5.2 slab per-record accelerated SHA-256 falsifier
method: Resolve OpenSSL 3 SHA256 with dlopen/dlsym, hash the exact 9,732,096-byte record size used by the slab 100 times, and compare with sha256sum over an equal zero-filled stream.
scope: Cheap offline falsifier only. It does not authorize a serving run; the candidate-bound allocation and integrity canary is still required.
